'''Seossra Thwisp''' was a [[Caphex]] [[Gender|female]] [[spy]] who served the [[Resistance]]. Keeping tabs on [[First Order]] activity along the borderlands, Thwisp was recalled into the Resistance after the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]], and began serving as an intelligence analyst.

She returned to the field to fight in the [[Battle of Exegol]] with the rest of the Resistance. After they successfully defeated the [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] of the [[Sith Eternal]], Thwisp returned to the [[moon]] [[Ajan Kloss]] to celebrate the victory.

==Biography==
Seossra Thwisp was a [[Caphex]] from [[Caphexdis]] who served the [[Resistance]] as a [[spy]] during their [[Cold War]] with the [[First Order]], keeping tabs on First Order activity along the borderlands. When full scale [[First Order-Resistance War|war]] broke out between the two factions following the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]]<ref name="TROS VD" /> in [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> Thwisp was recalled from spy duty and began serving as an intelligence analyst, offering up her accumulated expertise on the First Order.<ref name="TROS VD" />

In [[35 ABY]],<ref name="IX Dates">{{FilmDate|IX|Tidian's appearance}}</ref> Thwisp was amongst the Resistance personnel stationed in the [[Resistance base (Ajan Kloss)|Resistance base]] on the [[jungle]] [[moon]] of [[Ajan Kloss]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> She attended a meeting at the base following the [[death]] of Resistance leader [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], in which the new leader of the movement, General [[Poe Dameron]], briefed those present on a plan to [[Battle of Exegol|attack]] the [[Sith Eternal]] [[Final Order|forces]] stationed on the [[Unknown Regions]] [[planet]] [[Exegol]].<ref name="TROS" /> Thwisp then returned to the field as part of the Resistance's forces that traveled to Exegol, where the Resistance ultimately triumphed in the battle after a large fleet of allies arrived to reinforce them. Following the battle, Thwisp returned with many others to Ajan Kloss to celebrate. During the celebration she stood talking with a [[human]] and then began cheering as the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] and the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]] reunited.<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Seossra Thwisp had pale skin, [[Color|gray]] [[hair]] and black [[eye]]s.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
Seossra Thwisp wore a camouflage [[Clothing|parka]] with a brown [[belt]] and used a vintage [[DH-17 blaster rifle]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wizard_71.png|thumb|right|250px|Wizard 71 by Luke Fisher]]
Seossra Thwisp first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> Concept art of Thwisp titled "Wizard 71" was drawn by creature concept artist and senior sculptor [[Luke Fisher]]. The art depicted several Caphex, all much squatter and more hunch-backed<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> then Thwisp's final appearance in the film.<ref name="TROS" />
